comment: Replicated on seven of my own in-domain runs. Runs 005-010 are two-particle pairs at initial separation 3.00 for all six species pairs (AA, AB, AC, BB, BC, CC) at T=1: the lower edge of the claimed separation domain. Run 011 is a three-particle A, A, C triangle with sides 4.00 to 4.47, T=2. The P-0008 model.py predicts all seven at tracker-noise level: error (RMSE/10) 0.0047 to 0.0058, against a bar of 3 x 0.07 = 0.21. Not tested: none of my in-domain runs has four particles. My four-particle run 012 has a diagonal of 5.66, outside the stated domain, so I did not cite it; the four-body part of claim c1 is not checked by me. These runs sit at the tracker-noise floor, so they do not bound a three-body term below that noise.
